falklands.d: Gypsy Cove (out and back, short, easy, Oct-Mar); Maritime History Trail from Stanley toward Cape Pembroke (point to point, easy, Oct-Mar); Sea Lion Island walks (loop, easy, Oct-Mar)

faroe-islands.d: Kallur lighthouse on Kalsoy (out and back, about 3 to 5 miles, steady, May-Sep); Sorvagsvatn to Traelanipa (out and back, about 3 to 5 miles, steady, May-Sep); Saksun to Tjornuvik (point to point, steep, May-Sep)

fiji.d: Lavena Coastal Walk on Taveuni (out and back, about 3 hours round trip, easy to steady, May-Oct); Mount Batilamu on Viti Levu (walk-up summit, steep, May-Oct)

fjords.d: Trolltunga (out and back, about 17 miles, strenuous, Jun-Sep); Preikestolen (out and back, about 5 miles, steady, May-Oct); Kjeragbolten (out and back, about 6.5 miles, steep, Jun-Sep); Besseggen ridge (point to point, about 9 miles, steep, Jul-Sep)
fjords.m: Hardangervidda hut-to-hut routes (multi-day, mountain huts, trek, Jul-Sep)

galapagos.d: Bartolome summit stairs (out and back, about 1 mile with 372 steps, easy, year-round); Sierra Negra volcano rim (out and back, about 10 miles, steady, year-round; guide required)

gbr.d: Hill Inlet lookout on Whitsunday Island (out and back, about 1.5 miles, easy, May-Oct); Passage Peak on Hamilton Island (out and back, about 2 miles, steady, May-Oct)
gbr.m: Ngaro Sea Trail in the Whitsundays (multi-day, island campsites, trek, May-Oct)

ghana.d: Wli Falls lower tier (out and back, about 2 to 3 miles, easy, Nov-Mar); Mount Afadjato (out and back, short and steep, Nov-Mar; community guide); Kakum canopy walkway (loop, about 1 mile, easy, year-round; guided)

glacier-waterton.d: Highline Trail (point to point, about 11.8 miles, steady, Jul-Sep); Grinnell Glacier (out and back, about 10.6 miles, steep, Jul-Sep); Hidden Lake Overlook (out and back, about 2.7 miles, steady, Jul-Sep); Crypt Lake in Waterton (out and back, about 10.6 miles plus a boat, steep, Jul-Sep)
glacier-waterton.m: Gunsight Pass Trail (2 to 3 days, about 19 miles, backcountry campgrounds, trek, Jul-Sep)
glacier-waterton.st: No vehicle reservations are required in Glacier in 2026 (NPS news release). The Logan Pass shuttle is the main reservation system (60-day window opening 2 May) and Highline Trail hikers need it; Avalanche Lake and Trail of the Cedars are not served by the shuttle in 2026; one guide lists Two Medicine Campground as closed for the 2026 season.

grandcanyon.d: Bright Angel Trail to Indian Garden (out and back, about 9 miles, strenuous, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); South Kaibab to Ooh Aah Point (out and back, about 1.8 miles, steady, year-round); Rim Trail (point to point, up to 13 miles, easy, year-round)
grandcanyon.m: Rim-to-rim (2 to 3 days, about 24 miles, Phantom Ranch or camping with a permit, strenuous trek, May-Jun and Sep-Oct)
grandcanyon.st: A flash flood on 29 Aug 2026 damaged the Transcanyon Waterline and closed inner-canyon trails: South Kaibab below Tip-Off, Bright Angel below its Tonto junction, North Kaibab, Cottonwood Campground, Phantom Ranch and Bright Angel Campground, with no reopening date given as of early September 2026 (NPS, KNAU, KTAR). The North Rim reopening was scheduled for 15 May 2026 after the 2025 Dragon Bravo fire.

great-smoky-mountains.d: Alum Cave Trail to Mount LeConte (out and back, about 11 miles, steep, Apr-Oct); Charlies Bunion from Newfound Gap (out and back, about 8 miles, steady, Apr-Oct); Laurel Falls (out and back, about 2.4 miles, easy, year-round)
great-smoky-mountains.m: Appalachian Trail through the park (about 70 miles, backcountry shelters, trek, May-Oct)

greenland.d: Ilulissat Icefjord trails (loop, about 4 miles, easy, Jun-Sep); Sisimiut mountain day hikes (out and back, steady, Jun-Sep)
greenland.m: Arctic Circle Trail (7 to 10 days, about 100 miles, simple huts and camping, trek, Jun-Sep)

guatemala.d: Pacaya volcano (guided walk-up, about 3 hours round trip, steady, Nov-Apr); Indian Nose above Lake Atitlan (out and back, steady, Nov-Apr)
guatemala.m: Acatenango overnight (2 days, guided camp facing Fuego, strenuous trek, Nov-Apr)
guatemala.st: Fuego eruptions in 2025 halted overnight hikes at times; one 2026 report (single source, unconfirmed) says the acute eruptive phase ended on 5 Aug 2026 and Acatenango hiking has resumed. Guides are required; confirm with INSIVUMEH, CONRED or INGUAT.

guilin-yangshuo.d: Moon Hill (out and back, short and stair-heavy, year-round); Longji rice terrace paths from Dazhai to Tiantouzhai (point to point, steady, Apr-Oct)

havana.d: Vinales valley loops (loop, about 5 miles, easy, Nov-Apr); Topes de Collantes waterfall trail (out and back, steady, Nov-Apr)
havana.m: Pico Turquino (2 days, guided, camp huts, trek, Nov-Apr)

hokkaido.d: Asahidake Sugatami Pond circuit (loop, about 1.5 miles from the ropeway, easy, Jul-Sep); Shiretoko Five Lakes (loop, about 2 to 3 miles, easy, May-Oct; permit and bear briefing in bear season)
hokkaido.m: Daisetsuzan traverse (2 to 3 days, mountain huts and camping, trek, Jul-Sep)

hongkong.d: Dragon's Back (point to point, about 5 miles, easy to steady, Oct-Mar); Lantau Peak (walk-up summit, about 5 miles round trip, steep, Oct-Mar)
hongkong.m: MacLehose Trail (10 sections, 62 miles, day sections or camping, trek, Oct-Mar)

hudson-valley.d: Breakneck Ridge (loop, about 3.7 miles with scrambling, steep, Mar-Nov); Gertrude's Nose in Minnewaska (loop, about 8 miles, steady, Apr-Nov)

iceland.d: Mount Esja Steinn (out and back, about 5 miles, steep, Jun-Sep); Svartifoss from Skaftafell (out and back, about 2.7 miles, easy, May-Sep); Reykjadalur hot spring river (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, May-Oct)
iceland.m: Laugavegur (4 days, 34 miles, mountain huts, trek, Jul-Sep); Hornstrandir (4 to 7 days, camping, trek, Jul-Aug)
iceland.st: A secondhand report (3 Sept 2026) says SafeTravel advises against hiking Fimmvorduhals while dangerous conditions remain, and that F210 to the highlands has an impassable section while F208 to Landmannalaugar is reported open. Check SafeTravel.is, road.is and the Icelandic Touring Association before booking.

ireland.d: Carrauntoohil by the Devil's Ladder (out and back, about 7 miles, strenuous, May-Sep); Cliffs of Moher coastal walk (point to point, about 12 miles from Doolin to Liscannor, steady, Apr-Oct)
ireland.m: Kerry Way (9 days, about 130 miles, B&Bs, trek, May-Sep); Wicklow Way (6 to 7 days, about 80 miles, B&Bs and hostels, trek, May-Sep)

istanbul.d: Princes' Islands Buyukada loop (loop, about 5 miles, easy, Mar-Nov); Belgrad Forest trails (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, easy, Mar-Nov)

jamaica.d: Blue Mountain Peak (walk-up summit, about 3 to 4 hours up from Penlyne Castle, steep, Dec-Apr; start before dawn)

jordan.d: Petra to the Monastery (out and back, about 5 miles with 800 steps, steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Little Petra to Petra back-door trail (point to point, steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Wadi Rum guided desert walks (guided, easy to steady, Oct-Apr)
jordan.m: Jordan Trail (sections of 3 to 8 days, about 400 miles end to end, village homestays and camping, trek, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)

joshua-tree.d: Ryan Mountain (out and back, about 3 miles, steep, Oct-Apr); Hidden Valley Nature Trail (loop, about 1 mile, easy, Oct-Apr); Indian Canyons Palm Canyon (out and back, about 2 to 4 miles, easy, Oct-Apr)

kaziranga.d: Living root bridges of Nongriat (out and back, about 5 miles with about 3,500 steps, steep, Oct-May); Dzukou Valley (out and back, steady, Jun-Sep and Nov-Mar)
kaziranga.m: Dzukou Valley overnight trek (2 days, hut or camping, trek, Jun-Sep and Nov-Mar)

kenya.d: Hell's Gate gorge walk (loop, about 3 to 5 miles, easy, Jun-Feb); Maasai Mara conservancy bush walks (guided, easy, Jul-Oct)
kenya.m: Mount Kenya by the Sirimon and Naro Moru routes (3 to 5 days, mountain huts or camping, trek, Jan-Mar and Jul-Oct)

kerala.d: Meesapulimala near Munnar (out and back, long day with permit and authorized guide, steep, Dec-Mar)

komodo.d: Padar Island summit (out and back, about 1.5 miles, steep, Apr-Nov); Komodo and Rinca ranger-guided walks (loop, easy, Apr-Nov)
komodo.st: A daily visitor cap of about 1,000 has applied since 1 April 2026 (operator reports; book through the park's SiOra system). After the 15 Aug 2026 earthquake Komodo National Park stayed open, with Padar, Komodo and Rinca receiving visitors, but some inland Flores sites such as Liang Bua and Riung marine park were reported shut or restricted (operator blog, 1 Sept 2026).

kruger.d: Guided morning bush walks (guided, easy, Mar-Oct)
kruger.m: Kruger wilderness trails (3 nights, 15 to 20 km a day, rustic huts, guided, trek, Mar-Oct)
